name: Senton Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Senton Energy Co.,Ltd. engages in the procurement, transportation, and sale of LNG in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company also offers crude oil and general cargo transportation services; and operates LNG refueling stations and tanker trucks. It provides solutions to industrial fuels, city gas, and transportation fuels. Senton Energy Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2012 and is based in Yantai, the People's Republic of China.
